claims.head: Columbus’s power play outclasses St. Louis’s
claims.body: Columbus ranks 17th of 32 for power play, toward the lethal end; St. Louis ranks 32nd, toward the harmless end.
claims.call: Columbus’s power play creates more per 60 than St. Louis’s.

claims.body: St. Louis ranks 1st of 32 for shot quality, toward the point-blank end; Columbus ranks 13th, toward the perimeter end.

notes.text: L. Mailloux has not played this season. A. Jiricek is in his usual spot beside P. Broberg. That pair is getting 8:50 a game at 5-on-5, down from 11:56 with Mailloux.

STL.head: Leaning St. Louis’s way
STL.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and St. Louis has home ice. Not by much, though: Columbus can make it interesting if its penalty kill holds up.

CBJ.head: Columbus starts a half-step behind
CBJ.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and St. Louis has home ice. Columbus can tip it if its penalty kill holds up.
